name: kanon
description: Build systems in the terminal with an engineer while keeping the live visual map current.

interface.shortDescription: Build in the terminal. See the system evolve.
interface.longDescription: Keep modules, flows, and decisions in repository text while Kanon maintains a live system map beside your terminal work. Prepare coding-agent handoffs when needed.
defaultPrompt: Use Kanon to work on this system with me. Open its live map and keep the design and recorded decisions current as we work.
